sourcesId.description: Id of the {@link Sources} for the Source

title:
Base type for defining external data sources in the C3 Agentic AI Platform.
Custom source types should mix this type to ingest and transform data
from external systems (e.g., CSV, JSON, databases) into the platform.

This type can be used to serialize data from a {@link SourceCollection}
This is the base type of {@link Canonical},
representing raw external data that will eventually be transformed
into standardized internal formats for application use.
name: Source
